changelog:
Initial release of voice-to-text skill.

- Converts voice messages and audio files to text using the offline Vosk speech recognition toolkit.
- Supports multiple audio formats: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, AAC, WEBM, and voice messages from chat apps.
- Provides setup instructions for installing dependencies and downloading language models.
- Allows model selection for Chinese and English (fast and high-accuracy options).
- Runs fully offline (no internet required after setup).
